description: Revert to the proven stable 10-layer configuration (Matrix LR 0.06, Embedding LR 1.5, Total Batch 2^18, Weight Decay 0.1, Device Batch 128) to ensure a crash-free run and maximize the probability of achieving the best known val_bpb of 0.9777, as all recent architectural and hyperparameter modifications have resulted in instability, crashes, or worse results.
